critique: The render retains the intended black-and-magenta Form string aesthetic, and motion from t1 to t4 is now relatively stable rather than the severe repopulation seen previously. However, the image is still dominated by long, smooth, evenly spaced parallel bars. It reads as a cropped diagonal line grid, not a dense fractal-line field: the visible size modulation is too subtle, the strands have little internal variation, and several thick foreground strings are visually overpowering. The lower-edge spike groups also create an accidental clipped look rather than an evenly distributed fractal texture.

suggestions.why: Increase Fractal Field scale so the line-size variation occurs more frequently along and across the strings, making the field read as fractal rather than broad uniform bands.
Raise fractal complexity to introduce finer nested breakup and secondary detail within the magenta strings.
Reduce maximum particle size so the dominant foreground strands stop reading as soft solid light bars and reveal the intended granular string structure.
